$Comment:
What the Crafting tree's station stats pay at the Sawmill. Named by Extensions/SawmillProgression.json and rolled on every completed cycle. Each roll reads one or two of the MMO's station stats (Server/Entity/Stats/MMO_Station*.json in the MMO jar, each file saying what one point does) and nothing else: every stat is whole percent points read as a Chance, so 25 points is one cycle in four. A talent, a piece of gear carrying the stat (an item's StatModifiers) or a buff (an effect's stat modifiers) all count the same, and with none of them every roll here reads 0 and pays nothing, so a worker without the tree mills exactly as before.

The rolls that pay planks grant rpgstations:output_items, ONE more of the cycle's own product on a hit, on top of Recipe.Yield and the other ladders. The rolls that repeat a find grant a Lootable reward naming the band to roll again with Trigger Cycle, beside its Treasure Cut twin (Mmo_Sawmill_Treasure_Luck, Mmo_Sawmill_Treasure_Deep): each nested table is judged against this same cycle (the same score, the same Woodcutting gate, the same Mill Trade gates), so a second roll can never pay a tier the first could not, and each player gets the band that is theirs. Their Essence of Life half is Mmo_Sawmill_Find_Essence, a table of its own so Bulk Order's Requires can shut it.

Every number here is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: Planks: Crafting's main line (MMO_StationYield_CRAFTING, a quarter of a point for each Crafting tree point spent) and Clean Cuts (MMO_Station_Planks) summed into one chance of one more plank, held at 100 percent.
Everyday finds again: the everyday-find stat (MMO_Station_Find: Offcut Bin, Second Look) is the chance this cycle rolls the everyday band (SawmillLuckFinds) a second time.

The deep tiers again: the rarest-find stat (MMO_Station_Find_Rare: Rare Woods, Heart Seeker) is the chance this cycle rolls the deep band (SawmillDeepFinds, still behind its Woodcutting 30 gate) a second time.
In the Grain, the long-session stat (MMO_Station_Bonus_Session), plank half: once a session passes 20 cycles, the chance of one more plank.
In the Grain, find half: once a session passes 20 cycles, the same chance the cycle rolls the everyday band again.
